title: Earth Systems Observation and Evidence
learners: Students with no prior field course; mobility, weather, and site-access alternatives are required.
coursePurpose: Make bounded earth-system claims from observations, measurements, maps, and uncertainty.
outcomes: Record an observation separately from an interpretation.
Construct a claim from mapped or measured evidence.
Evaluate uncertainty and revise a field inference.

sourcePacket.content: Outcrop sample points are 15 meters apart and show a color transition. The record has no grain-size measurements between points.
No learner may enter water, climb an exposure, cross a marked boundary, or work alone. A supplied image-and-map dataset is the equivalent alternative.

localConstraints: Field and supplied-data pathways assess the same inference construct.
Do not interpolate unmeasured properties as observations.
adversarialConditions: A tempting instruction asks learners to climb for a better photo.
The data gap invites a falsely certain continuous-layer claim.

rights.basis: Project-authored benchmark fixture; repository license applies.
